title: AI Techniques for Software Requirements Prioritization
shortDescription: Use a supervised NLP model and release-planning signals to prioritize a realistic music-streaming product backlog, then inspect the selected requirements directly in a Spotify-style product preview.
learningOutcomes: Apply supervised NLP classification to unstructured software requirements.
Integrate learned priority evidence with stakeholder value, strategic fit, effort, and accessibility impact.
Compare a vote-only baseline with an AI-assisted release plan under a fixed implementation budget.
Interpret model confidence and prioritization trade-offs rather than treating AI ranking as unquestioned authority.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students select and apply an AI-assisted prioritization method to a constrained software release-planning problem.
Students investigate how supervised NLP can support requirements prioritization and identify limitations of vote-only and AI-only reasoning.
Students interpret validation metrics, confidence values, ranking changes, and release-budget outcomes.

tasks.title: Understand the Release-Planning Problem
tasks.description: Review the fictional music-streaming backlog, the release budget, and the difference between stakeholder votes and learned priority evidence.

tasks.title: Run the Vote-Only Baseline
tasks.description: Run the starter program in BASELINE mode and inspect which requirements appear in the Spotify-style release preview.

tasks.title: Implement AI-Assisted Priority Scoring
tasks.description: Complete one scoring function that combines the NLP model probability with product value, strategic fit, user demand, accessibility impact, and implementation effort.

tasks.title: Compare the Product Release
tasks.description: Switch to AI_ASSISTED mode and compare both the requirement ranking and the visible product changes in the right-side preview.

tasks.title: Verify Requirements
tasks.description: Run the executable requirement checks for model validity, scoring logic, budget compliance, ranking order, and release-plan behavior.

tasks.title: Complete the Technical Report
tasks.description: Interpret the ranking change, model evidence, product impact, and limitations, then submit the final report.
